name: Soulforge Aptitude
descriptionTemplate:
·This talent only takes effect in {Astral Reign} stages.
·This Awaker's CON, ATK, and DEF are increased by [Arg1]%, and this Awaker gains [Arg2] Aliemus after first {Rouse}.
·Strength gained by all Awakers is increased by [Arg3]%.
·When Clementine deals DMG to "Insectoid" enemies, inflicts {Bleed} equal to [Arg4]% of the DMG dealt. The first time each turn Clementine grants a shield or restores HP, "Insectoid" enemies temporarily lose Strength equal to [Arg5]% of Clementine's DEF.
